spine: Reason is a practice before it is a faculty.
The scholastic disputation institutionalized arguing both sides.
The Enlightenment inherited the practice while disavowing the institution.
A constitution of reason is a set of disciplines, not a set of axioms.

sections.title: The faculty and the practice
sections.purpose: Set the thesis: reason as a trained practice.

sections.title: The Enlightenment's disavowal
sections.purpose: Trace the inheritance and its denial.

alternativesConsidered: Open with Kant rather than the scholastics (rejected: buries the practice claim).
gaps: Need one primary source for the disputation's two-sided requirement.
